verdict.rationale: Coinbase documents a dedicated custom-stablecoin issuance product where Coinbase manages issuance, redemption, and reserves for a 1:1 USDC-backed branded stablecoin, directly matching the core story. However, the evidence gives only a single overview-line description with no detail on gating/eligibility requirements, pricing, application process, or independent corroboration of how honestly the gating is quoted. Missing for 10: documented eligibility/gating criteria, pricing/fees, and third-party or hands-on confirmation of the issuance workflow.
